source_text: Every day, Lenovo employees create valuable knowledge. We document best practices. We solve customer problems. We develop products. We create presentations, reports, training materials, and operational processes. But there is one challenge we all face: Knowledge is everywhere. It lives in emails, shared drives, SharePoint sites, Teams channels, documents, videos, and sometimes only in people's heads. Knowledge Management turns knowledge into a shared, trusted enterprise asset breaking it out of silos to serve employees through faster access and smarter decisions, while providing the governed foundation that powers enterprise AI. When knowledge is scattered, difficult to find, and hard to maintain, employees spend too much time searching for information instead of using it. And as AI agents consume knowledge at scale, it must be governed to ensure high quality and accessibility.
